chain_words.nuance: slightly hard to handle, needing care
hard in a way that tests your skills
requires a lot of time, energy or attention
formal; very hard work that takes sustained effort
so hard that it leaves you exhausted

explanation: These words all describe something difficult, but they differ in strength, from a small technical problem to work that exhausts you.

usage_notes.difference: 'Challenging' describes a task that tests your skills in an interesting way; 'demanding' stresses that a job takes a lot of time, energy or attention.
